description:
The Huffy Granite 24-inch bike is designed for riders ages 10 and up who are typically between 58 and 70 inches tall. Its confident sizing and durable steel frame create a stable, comfortable ride for growing kids and teens.
A 5-speed drivetrain with an easy twist shifter helps riders take on small hills, flat roads, and changing terrain with ease. Smooth shifting keeps the ride fun and frustration-free.
Front and rear hand brakes deliver dependable stopping power when it matters most. Whether cruising downhill or slowing at an intersection, riders stay in control and ride with confidence.
Wide 24-inch tires add traction and stability, while the mountain-inspired design keeps the look clean and capable. The Granite is ready for everyday rides, weekend exploring, and new challenges.
